triggers.detailsText: 1 crore = 10 million Refer to Annexure for Details of Instruments & Bank Facilities Detailed Rationale Crisil Ratings has assigned its ‘Crisil A+/Stable/Crisil A1’ ratings to the bank facilities of Piccadily Agro Industries Limited (PAIL). PAIL’s operating income grew at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 16% from fiscal 2020 to Rs 1,038 crore in fiscal 2026, driven by a 32% CAGR growth in revenue of distillery segment. PAIL’s operating margin has increased from 10% in fiscal 2020 to 22.5% in fiscal 2026 and is expected to be 22–24% in fiscal 2027 supported by increasing share of distillery segment.

PAIL’s operating margin has increased from 10% in fiscal 2020 to 22.5% in fiscal 2026 and is expected to be 22–24% in fiscal 2027 supported by increasing share of distillery segment.
